Question 13(c) [4 marks]: With reference to a business you have studied, explain how global sourcing impacts operations management.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Provides cause and effect in a case study addressing how global sourcing impacts operations management
3 marks: Provides characteristics and features in a case study addressing how global sourcing impacts operations management
2 marks: Provides theoretical cause and effect addressing how global sourcing impacts operations management
1 marks: Provides characteristics and features addressing how global sourcing impacts operations management

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Global sourcing refers to a business sourcing transformed and transforming resources from overseas suppliers rather than only domestic suppliers. Global sourcing impacts operations management for global toy manufacturer LEGO, based in Denmark. LEGO sources its computer-controlled inventory management reports and plant logistics, used in factories in Denmark, Mexico, the Czech Republic and China, from a Swiss manufacturer who provides remote diagnostics and maintenance via the internet. The impacts on operations management include reduced cost, increased quality and greater inventory efficiencies, although it introduces complexity in having support via Switzerland and dependence on the supplier if difficulties are encountered.
